identity.title: Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire - Limited Edition Collection

leadText:
The Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire - Limited Edition Collection is a Region 4 DVD set released by in Australia on November 19, 2014 and in New Zealand on December 10, 2014. This DVD set is also referred to as the Pokémon Ruby & Sapphire Region Collector's Edition in promotional material. It contains four individual DVD cases with uniform covers that each contain a number of discs. Overall, the set includes 23 discs with 191 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE5782. The DVDs do not include English closed captioning.

It contains all of the episodes from Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire. Specifically, it has episodes from Advanced, Advanced Challenge, Advanced Battle, and Battle Frontier.

==Contents==
===Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire - Part 1===
 
Part 1 contains 40 episodes across 5 discs.
 

===Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire - Part 2===
 
Part 2 contains 52 episodes across 6 discs.
 

===Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire - Part 3===
 
Part 3 contains 52 episodes across 6 discs.
 

===Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire - Part 4===
 
Part 2 contains 47 episodes across 6 discs.
